description: This file contains PHP code that interacts with the TestLink API to create test cases via an XML-RPC client. It includes external dependencies, sets up test case parameters, and makes calls to the `runTest` function with different test case configurations.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A class representing an XML-RPC client used to communicate with the TestLink API.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: Function to execute a test case by calling the `IXR_Client` with specified method and arguments.
